mechanism_narrative: A lower current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.0% signals a tight labor market that boosts corporate profit margins and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of months where UNRATE < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor force growth (PAYEMS) is above its 12-month moving average and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5%, the combined strength of the labor market signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 12mo MA and UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by RSAFS above 680,000 million dollars and HOUST above 1400 thousand units), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to profit-taking and rising interest rate expectations, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS > 680000 and HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in sustained demand growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of months where HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling simultaneously, it signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the market prices in higher borrowing costs and reduced growth potential.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and UNRATE decreases in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts above 1450 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to immediate demand strength.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 40% of months where HOUST > 1450.
